executive_summary: Loyalty has a DATA SSOT (users.loyalty_points + loyalty_transactions ledger) but NO SERVICE SSOT. Earn/redeem logic is fragmented across: AwardLoyaltyPointsOnDelivery listener (earn), LoyaltyController (redeem/check/register/balance/scan/config/history/optIn), LoyaltyService (refund only, 80 lines), DiscountCalculator (pricing-side preview). Each surface calls the same API endpoints, so cross-surface balance consistency is correct IN THEORY — but no integration test asserts 'POS earn -> Mobile balance shows new total -> Kiosk redeem -> Web shows decrement' as a single chain. Web 'mirror' (/Users/1millnonstop/Downloads/web/loyalty-v2.jsx, 141 lines) is profile chrome only — no QR, no balance, no redeem; cross-surface coverage gap. Wallet (Apple/Google) entirely deferred — only V0 modal placeholder + WALLET_PLAN.md spec; no AppleWalletPassService or GoogleWalletService classes exist.

data_ssot.ledger: loyalty_transactions table (type: earn|redeem|manual_add, source_surface, balance_after immutable snapshot)
data_ssot.order_link: orders.loyalty_customer_code (FK by code, not user_id — supports kiosk anonymous flow where order user_id = kiosk machine account)
data_ssot.consent: loyalty_consents (RGPD audit trail, ip_hash + ua_hash, privacy_notice_version)

ssot_map.service_ssot_status: ABSENT — logic spread across listener + controller + 2 services + pricing calculator. LoyaltyService::refundPoints is the ONLY method in LoyaltyService. Recommended V1.0.2 consolidation: extract earn/redeem/refund into BackendLoyaltyService with idempotent operations.
ssot_map.config_ssot: Smartisan\Settings 'loyalty_setup' group — admin-editable. Keys: loyalty_points_per_euro (default 10), loyalty_points_for_1_euro_discount (default 100), loyalty_min_redeem_points (default 50), loyalty_tiers (CSV). GET /api/frontend/loyalty/config returns this — mobile/kiosk/web fetch + cache.

POS.earn: AwardLoyaltyPointsOnDelivery listener on OrderStatusChanged event — triggers on DELIVERED status for non-kiosk orders. Source_surface stamped as $order->source_surface ?? 'web' (POS orders should set 'pos' explicitly — verify).
POS.redeem: NONE in V1 per owner directive. PosOrderRequest accepts loyalty_customer_code (nullable) — used to ATTRIBUTE earn to a customer but does NOT redeem points. Owner now wants cashier redeem UI added (LOCK pos-wizard.js parallel cycle).
POS.scan_input: Manual entry via PosOrderRequest validation 'min:4,max:25' OR CustomerNfcLookupController (NFC scan, returns loyalty_points)
POS.endpoint_used: PosOrderRequest hands code to OrderService::create which sets Order::loyalty_customer_code; earn fires later on status transition

Kiosk.earn: Same listener (kiosk path triggers on PREPARED or DELIVERED — kiosk flow doesn't reach DELIVERED). User resolution: FrontendOrder.loyalty_customer_code -> User::where('loyalty_code', X). Source_surface = 'kiosk'.
Kiosk.redeem: POST /api/v1/frontend/loyalty/redeem (auth:sanctum, kiosk:order ability check inline in controller). DB transaction + lockForUpdate prevents race. Validates multiple-of-rate. Writes ledger row with type=redeem, source_surface='kiosk'.
Kiosk.scan_input: POST /api/v1/frontend/loyalty/scan (auth:sanctum, throttle:20,1, kiosk:order ability check inline). Returns opaque customer_token + balance + allergens. Strips FK: prefix. Falls back to phone E.164 lookup if loyalty_code not found.
Kiosk.register: POST /api/v1/frontend/loyalty/opt-in (RGPD consent + LoyaltyConsent log) OR legacy /register (no consent)
Kiosk.ui: KioskLoyaltyComponent.vue (1071 lines, NOT in frozen list — wizard kiosk auditable per feedback 2026-05-07)

Mobile.earn: Display only — consumes /loyalty/history + /loyalty/balance. Mobile DOES NOT earn directly; mobile order placement (when wired) would flow through POS or kiosk listener.
Mobile.redeem: POST /loyalty/redeem with Idempotency-Key header (mobile/data/loyalty.js:24 mentions B-02 from audit — sent client-side BUT route /loyalty/redeem at routes/api.php:1278 does NOT apply IdempotencyKeyMiddleware — only auth:sanctum). GAP.
Mobile.qr: useLoyaltyQR hook (5min rotation, chained setTimeout, visibilitychange listener). QR payload = 'FK:<loyalty_code>'. generateSignedQR is 100% client-side mock (mobile/data/loyalty.js:174) — NO server endpoint /loyalty/qr/sign exists in V0 backend.
Mobile.wallet: ModalWalletV0Notice placeholder only — Apple/Google buttons open informational modal. No real pass generation. WALLET_PLAN.md is the spec, not implementation.
Mobile.tests: 22 E2E specs PASS (15 features + 5 adversarial + 1 fictional-purge + 1 contrast-inspect)

Web.status: NO loyalty wallet surface exists. /Users/1millnonstop/Downloads/web/loyalty-v2.jsx (141 lines) = ProfileEditor / NotificationSettings / SavedCards / PreferencesCard / AccountDangerZone — exports LoyaltyProfileTab. ZERO QR, ZERO balance display, ZERO redeem UI, ZERO history feed.
Web.cross_surface_gap: Web cannot show same code/balance as mobile — surface is structurally absent. This contradicts task framing 'web = mirror'.

balance_consistency_analysis.happens_path: All surfaces read from same User.loyalty_points column via /loyalty/balance or /loyalty/check. Same code shown on Mobile = same balance returned to Kiosk scan. Verified at controller layer: LoyaltyController::check (line 86) reads $user->loyalty_points; ::scan (line 649) reads (int) ($target->loyalty_points ?? 0); same source.
balance_consistency_analysis.race_conditions: Redeem uses DB::transaction + lockForUpdate (line 274). Earn uses atomic sentinel UPDATE WHERE loyalty_points_awarded IS NULL (line 53-56). Refund uses lockForUpdate (non-sqlite). Increment via DB::table()->increment is atomic at row level.
weak_links: Mobile redeem sends Idempotency-Key header but /loyalty/redeem route lacks IdempotencyKeyMiddleware enforcement — double-tap redeem from mobile can produce TWO ledger rows IF DB transaction allows (Kiosk path uses transaction so DB-level uniqueness saves it for now, but route-level idempotency is the proper boundary).

loyalty_transactions has no unique constraint on (user_id, order_id, type) for earn deduplication — relies entirely on orders.loyalty_points_awarded sentinel (UPDATE 1 row trick is correct, but if listener bypassed via different event path, dup is possible).
AwardLoyaltyPointsOnDelivery does NOT propagate to mobile in real-time — mobile polls or refreshes manually. No push channel. Acceptable for V1 but a UX gap.

event_sourcing_assessment.current_pattern: Hybrid: state column (users.loyalty_points) + immutable ledger (loyalty_transactions with balance_after snapshot). NOT pure event-sourcing. Balance is computed by UPDATE/increment, NOT by replaying ledger.
event_sourcing_assessment.rebuild_capability: Could reconstruct balance from SUM(loyalty_transactions.points) — but no test asserts users.loyalty_points == SUM(ledger). Drift possible if a path writes one without the other (refundPoints writes both, earn writes both, redeem writes both — manual_add via /add-points endpoint also writes both per controller line 212-217).
event_sourcing_assessment.recommendation: V1.0.2: add daily reconciliation job comparing users.loyalty_points vs SUM(ledger.points) per user; alert on mismatch.

cross_surface_invariants.I3_earn_post_order_visible_in_history: PASS — ledger row written in same DB transaction as balance increment
cross_surface_invariants.I4_refund_on_cancel_reverses: PASS — LoyaltyService::refundPoints called from OrderService cancel paths (line 1697 POS, 1800 web), FrontendOrderService line 707 (kiosk)
cross_surface_invariants.I5_web_mirrors_mobile: FAIL — web has no loyalty wallet surface (only profile chrome)
cross_surface_invariants.I7_qr_code_unique_per_session: FAIL — QR payload is static FK:<loyalty_code>, not nonced; rotation is cosmetic

findings.title: No service SSOT — earn in listener, redeem in controller, refund in service, preview in pricing calculator
findings.impact: Future feature additions (e.g. loyalty tiers, bonus campaigns) will require modifying 4+ files. Risk of inconsistent business rules across surfaces.
findings.recommendation: V1.0.2: extract BackendLoyaltyService with earn/redeem/refund/preview/balance methods. Keep controllers as thin HTTP adapters.

findings.title: Web has no loyalty wallet surface — only profile chrome
findings.impact: Cross-surface coverage broken; web users cannot view balance, QR, history, or redeem. Task framing 'web mirror of mobile' is unmet.
findings.recommendation: OWNER GATE: confirm whether web wallet surface is V1 scope or V1.x backlog. If V1 — port mobile LoyaltyQR + balance card + history to web with same /loyalty/* endpoints. If V1.x — document explicit deferral so 'mirror' framing is removed.

findings.title: No balance vs ledger reconciliation job
findings.impact: Silent drift between users.loyalty_points and SUM(loyalty_transactions.points) per user goes undetected.
findings.recommendation: V1.0.2: add LoyaltyReconcileCommand running daily; alert + heal on mismatch.

findings.title: Mobile/Apple/Google Wallet deferred — only V0 placeholder modal
findings.impact: Customers cannot save loyalty pass to native Wallet apps. Marketing/retention gap.
findings.recommendation: OWNER GATE: confirm V1 ships without Wallet (acceptable — WALLET_PLAN.md frames it as Phase 7+). Document explicit deferral; mobile button must continue to show V0 notice, not silently fail.

findings.title: POS source_surface stamping defaults to 'web' instead of 'pos'
findings.impact: Analytics will mis-attribute POS-earned points to web channel unless order->source_surface explicitly set to 'pos' by OrderService.
findings.recommendation: Verify OrderService::create sets source_surface='pos' for POS orders; if not, fix the fallback to 'pos' for non-kiosk path.

frozen_zone_status: KioskLoyaltyComponent.vue not in frozen list. LoyaltyService.php not in frozen list (NF525 frozen scope is FiscalSequenceService/ZReportService/AuditLogService). BranchScope unchanged. PricingService unchanged. POS-wizard.js (frozen) NOT touched by any loyalty change.
verdict: ARCHITECTURE: cross-surface data SSOT is sound; service SSOT absent but acceptable for V1. P1: web mirror gap is the largest cross-surface coherence break. Recommend OWNER GATE on (web wallet scope) + (V1 wallet deferral) before claiming cross-surface coverage complete.
